summary: Array/aggregate initializer. Always zeroes the first element (this+0x0); when the a2 init flag is non-zero, also zeroes this+0x4 through this+0x10. Then loops 104 times invoking PerElementArrayReset(this, i) per element and returns the last reset call's result.

local_names.a2: init flag; when non-zero, four additional leading fields are cleared
local_names.i: loop index over the 104 reset iterations
local_names.result: return value of the final PerElementArrayReset call

operations.description: Zero the first aggregate element at this+0x0 unconditionally.
When the a2 init flag is non-zero, clear the following four fields this+0x4 .. this+0x10.
Clear the field at this+0x4 to 0.
Clear the field at this+0x8 to 0.
Clear the field at this+0xC to 0.
Clear the field at this+0x10 to 0.
Loop 104 times with index i from 0 to 103, resetting each element in turn.
Invoke PerElementArrayReset (0x0045C850) on this with the current index i each iteration; the last call's return value is retained as result.
Return the result of the final PerElementArrayReset call.
Invoked by WrapperWithConstant (0x0045C750), RunCollisionDetectionLoop (0x0045F390), and SynchronizeWithServer (0x00464290).
